features.title: Source adapter contract
features.user_value: Use several runic catalogues without pretending their fields or update cadence are identical.
features.mechanism: Specify a read-only import interface with source ID, retrieval method, field mapping, license, availability, pagination, format, last checked timestamp, and explicit unsupported fields.
features.acceptance_test: Two differently structured sample source records normalize into one schema with unmapped values preserved and a documented access failure state.
features.constraint_or_tradeoff: Do not claim a public API without checking; use manual import or stable deep links where extraction is restricted.

features.title: Cross-corpus identity resolver
features.user_value: Avoid double-counting one object under several signa and catalogues.
features.mechanism: Create an alias table joining external signa to one internal witness ID only when repository identity, object description, and cited cross-reference support the match; preserve near-matches unmerged.
features.acceptance_test: A repeated monument merges as one witness with several external aliases, while two similarly named monuments remain distinct.
features.constraint_or_tradeoff: False merges are expensive; uncertain links default to suggested rather than automatic.

features.title: Coverage and denominator explorer
features.user_value: Make claims like most, rare, or common defensible within a defined corpus.
features.mechanism: Store query filters, version, geographical/temporal boundaries, total in-scope records, exclusions, missing metadata, and the subset exhibiting the tested property.
features.acceptance_test: Every reported frequency shows numerator, denominator, corpus snapshot, filtering method, and missing-data caveat.
features.constraint_or_tradeoff: Different archives have unequal coverage; never silently add raw totals.

features.title: Source snapshot and drift tracker
features.user_value: Know when a catalogue entry or scholarly reading has changed since the last investigation.
features.mechanism: Capture authorized source snapshots, hashes and retrieval dates; compare material fields such as reading, date range, provenance, and external ID between versions.
features.acceptance_test: A changed published interpretation produces an inspectable diff without overwriting the older cited state.
features.constraint_or_tradeoff: Respect access terms and retention requirements; content must not be scraped without authorization.

features.title: Rights-aware media gateway
features.user_value: Prevent accidental republication of restricted facsimiles, photos, and database contents.
features.mechanism: Assign independently checked permissions for metadata, thumbnails, originals, derivative crops, caching, redistribution, and required credit strings.
features.acceptance_test: An unlicensed image can be viewed through an allowed deep link but cannot appear in a downloadable public evidence pack.
features.constraint_or_tradeoff: A public page is not equivalent to an unrestricted reuse license.
features.inspiration: Rundata reuse conditions / IIIF rights metadata

features.title: Geography and find-context explorer
features.user_value: See how inscriptions relate to findspots, current repositories, writing contexts, and movement of objects.
features.mechanism: Maintain separate coordinates for archaeological findspot and current holding location, with dated uncertainty radii and no coordinates inferred from vague region labels.
features.acceptance_test: A museum relocation does not change findspot, and a vague regional attribution is rendered as uncertain rather than a precise map pin.
features.constraint_or_tradeoff: Geographical gaps and modern repository locations can mislead unless shown separately.

features.title: Region-precise evidence anchors
features.user_value: Let a reader inspect the exact strokes behind a conclusion, not merely a linked page.
features.mechanism: Store image ID, IIIF canvas when available, stable URL, normalized xywh polygon, scaling transformation, and citation of the evidence passage; use W3C Web Annotation for export.
features.acceptance_test: Clicking a claim highlights the same region on the original source image after zoom and resize, with a reliable fallback source link.
features.constraint_or_tradeoff: Source image must be actually available; never synthesize missing pixels.

features.title: Folio and page-order integrity checker
features.user_value: Stop manuscript dates and folio/page confusion from contaminating magical-stave attribution.
features.mechanism: Represent recto, verso, manuscript foliation, modern printed page, viewer canvas index and any rebinding ambiguity as separate attributes; compare references before publishing.
features.acceptance_test: A mismatch between folio 26v and page 26 triggers a review warning instead of an automatic substitution.
features.constraint_or_tradeoff: External descriptions may disagree; unresolved page indexing must stay flagged.

features.title: Stroke-topology signature
features.user_value: Compare two glyphs in terms of geometry rather than evocative resemblance.
features.mechanism: Describe endpoints, intersections, branches, connectivity, order constraints and orientation as a graph; save analysis independently of any proposed rune name.
features.acceptance_test: Mirrored, rotated and branch-added test variants produce explainable geometric differences without being labeled historical descendants.
features.constraint_or_tradeoff: Damage and artistic copying make a topology score advisory, not authoritative.

features.title: Reference-to-reference comparator
features.user_value: Inspect a manuscript image and a contemporary symbol beside one another with precise alignment.
features.mechanism: Implement synchronized zoom, transparency overlay, independent rotation, left/right flip flags, and exportable stroke-level discrepancy annotations.
features.acceptance_test: A comparison report lists strokes gained, lost, mirrored, shifted or simplified and links each image to its distinct source.
features.constraint_or_tradeoff: Do not conceal transformations: overlays can create deceptive matches.

features.title: Similarity candidate queue
features.user_value: Reduce time spent manually searching likely visual relatives without manufacturing lineage.
features.mechanism: Offer stroke-level candidate retrieval ranked with disclosed similarity features and source dates; all hits start as GRAPHIC RESEMBLANCE ONLY.
features.acceptance_test: A visually close result cannot become a transmission edge without new external documentary evidence.
features.constraint_or_tradeoff: False positives increase with simple radial shapes; human adjudication is mandatory.

features.title: Illegibility and damage layer
features.user_value: Avoid converting missing, worn, cropped or indecipherable marks into confidently decoded runes.
features.mechanism: Mark obscured source areas with a region mask; distinguish not visible, damaged, ambiguous stroke and post-processing artifact; attach readings only to visible or explicitly reconstructed geometry.
features.acceptance_test: A deliberately erased branch stays UNKNOWN after auto-analysis and a reconstruction is visually distinguished from the witness.
features.constraint_or_tradeoff: Automatic enhancement must never replace the untouched original in the evidence chain.

features.title: Script and period consistency linter
features.user_value: Catch hybrid Elder/Younger Futhark glyph combinations passed off as one historical inscription.
features.mechanism: Check each proposed rune form against the chosen inscription system, chronological range and orthographic context, with documented exceptions and ambiguity handling.
features.acceptance_test: A proposed mixed-alphabet Viking-Age rune name monogram is flagged with the precise incompatible components; a modern mix is allowed when honestly labeled.
features.constraint_or_tradeoff: Historical rune variants overlap; linter warnings are not categorical dating proof.

features.title: Round-trip transliteration checker
features.user_value: Detect information loss when converting glyphs to Latin script, normalized words and translations.
features.mechanism: Persist diplomatic glyph sequence, transliteration, normalized text and translation separately; round-trip comparison reports irreversible stages, multi-valued mappings and editorial additions.
features.acceptance_test: Ambiguous phoneme-to-rune reconstruction explicitly lists multiple possibilities rather than claiming a single authentic spelling.
features.constraint_or_tradeoff: Exact inverse transliteration is often impossible; mark irreversibility instead of inventing certainty.

features.title: Alternative reading lattice
features.user_value: Keep multiple scholarly readings alive as structured alternatives rather than averaging them.
features.mechanism: Store competing segmentation, direction, rune readings and translated phrases as linked branches with explicit supporting authorities and unresolved branches.
features.acceptance_test: Two defensible alternatives remain independently citable in exported analysis and downstream conclusions inherit their uncertainty.
features.constraint_or_tradeoff: Readers may disagree for legitimate reasons; majority vote is not a substitute for philology.

features.title: Ligature boundary analyser
features.user_value: Distinguish real ligatures and same-stave writing from a decorative overlay.
features.mechanism: Encode shared strokes and component ordering, including cross-word ligatures, separately from semantic keyword overlays and arbitrary contemporary strokes.
features.acceptance_test: A case in which a historical bind-rune crosses a word boundary is represented without forcing one lexical word.
features.constraint_or_tradeoff: Requires checked transcription; many shapes allow several structural decompositions.

features.title: Semantic category firewall
features.user_value: Prevent an interpretation from moving unnoticed across linguistic and historical categories.
features.mechanism: Require tagged statements for sound value, rune name, literal etymology, poem imagery, ritual evidence, and modern esoteric association; reject cross-category export without an explicit inference edge.
features.acceptance_test: A modern Fehu prosperity keyword cannot appear as a documented Viking-Age spell effect without a separate supporting witness.
features.constraint_or_tradeoff: Cannot decide scholarly debates alone; enforces claim types and needed evidence.

features.title: Etymology and language register
features.user_value: Stop an English modern keyword being treated as an Old Norse source term.
features.mechanism: Attach reconstructed protolanguage forms, attested medieval words, manuscript spellings and modern translation choices as distinct dated and sourced lexemes.
features.acceptance_test: A contested reconstruction is displayed with its argument and period, not silently turned into an attested inscription.
features.constraint_or_tradeoff: Critical dictionaries and manuscripts still need human checking.

features.title: Claim-dependency change propagation
features.user_value: Make later conclusions automatically aware when a decisive source or date is revised.
features.mechanism: Connect assertions to constituent source, witness, date, transcription and interpretation records with typed support edges; invalidate only dependent derived claims after edits.
features.acceptance_test: Changing the date of a cited manuscript marks each affected origin claim NEEDS RECHECK without modifying unrelated claims.
features.constraint_or_tradeoff: Avoid cycles and accidental propagation from resemblance-only edges.

features.title: Chronological contradiction detector
features.user_value: Catch impossible ancestry and retrojected modern labels.
features.mechanism: Check earliest/latest witness ranges, uncertain dates, copy dates, proposed origin dates and transmission directions; flag, rather than silently resolve, impossible or unproven sequences.
features.acceptance_test: A twentieth-century design cannot be used as positive proof of a ninth-century Viking glyph merely because its component runes are old.
features.constraint_or_tradeoff: Survival bias prevents ruling out undocumented predecessors solely from an early known date.

features.title: Independent-source clusterer
features.user_value: Stop ten websites repeating one unsourced symbol chart from posing as ten corroborations.
features.mechanism: Track shared images, edition references, bibliographies, author attribution, copied text and dates; group derivative pages under one provisional evidence lineage.
features.acceptance_test: Five near-identical modern chart copies count as one upstream claim family unless independent witnesses are demonstrated.
features.constraint_or_tradeoff: Similar wording does not always prove direct copying; clusters need review.

features.title: Disagreement dossier
features.user_value: Show genuine scholarly disagreement without false consensus.
features.mechanism: Store the exact disputed proposition, positions, cited source passages, different methods, and unresolved access; render parallel arguments rather than a combined averaged verdict.
features.acceptance_test: A debated ritual reading displays strongest arguments for both interpretations and what evidence could discriminate between them.
features.constraint_or_tradeoff: Not all positions carry equal evidence; disagreement is not proof of equivalence.

features.title: Transmission-edge burden-of-proof gate
features.user_value: Block visual similarity being recast as documented continuity.
features.mechanism: Constrain edges to DOCUMENTED COPYING, STRONG ATTRIBUTION, POSSIBLE INFLUENCE or GRAPHIC RESEMBLANCE, each with a source-level threshold and independent audit trail.
features.acceptance_test: Only a cited chain of transmission can earn DOCUMENTED COPYING; unsourced similarity stays resemblance even if nearly identical.
features.constraint_or_tradeoff: Traceability is evidence for claims, not certainty about unknowable author intent.

features.title: Multiple firsts timeline
features.user_value: Explain why earliest symbol, first name and first claimed magical purpose may fall in different centuries.
features.mechanism: Store first located form, name, function, print publication, modern reuse and first observed online circulation separately with confidence and location.
features.acceptance_test: An early literary name does not inherit the copying date of a later manuscript illustration, and vice versa.
features.constraint_or_tradeoff: First located is never declared first ever without a justified exhaustive evidence basis.

features.title: Information-gain search planner
features.user_value: Spend research effort where one source could actually change an important answer.
features.mechanism: Queue queries by claim impact, dispute severity, available primary sources, likely discrimination and estimated cost; stop broad searches that only yield mirrors.
features.acceptance_test: For a disputed date, direct manuscript catalogue and facsimile checks precede another generic image search.
features.constraint_or_tradeoff: Ranking is advisory and must allow expert overrides.

features.title: Bounded negative-search receipt
features.user_value: Make failed source searches useful without converting absence into proof of nonexistence.
features.mechanism: Record exact searched collections, language variants, date bounds, query, filters, snapshot, attempts, excluded areas and next plausible corpus.
features.acceptance_test: A conclusion of NO MATCH FOUND enumerates its actual coverage and cannot be rendered as HISTORICALLY IMPOSSIBLE.
features.constraint_or_tradeoff: Inaccessible or private collections remain explicit blind spots.

features.title: Two-tier source cache
features.user_value: Minimize repeated retrieval while noticing when mutable records have changed.
features.mechanism: Use immutable hash-addressed local witness snapshots and a separate expiring metadata cache, keyed by repository, identifier, language, query and version; log cache hits.
features.acceptance_test: Rerunning identical queries does not re-fetch stable witness bytes; changing source metadata invalidates dependent search results.
features.constraint_or_tradeoff: Respect source terms, conditional requests and required deletions.

features.title: Checkpointed research queue
features.user_value: Resume large investigations without redoing completed cases or losing unresolved evidence.
features.mechanism: Write atomic phase and item checkpoints with input/source digests, done/pending/blocked states, replay-safe task IDs, and idempotent processing.
features.acceptance_test: After simulated interruption, restart processes only missing/invalidated items and retains the complete old evidence trail.
features.constraint_or_tradeoff: Prevent checkpoint and claim database divergence with transaction tests.

features.title: Research cost and latency telemetry
features.user_value: Measure performance instead of claiming a prompt is efficient.
features.mechanism: Collect per-stage elapsed time, source calls, bytes, duplicate findings, claims validated, blocked cases and cache hit rate; measure under repeatable fixtures.
features.acceptance_test: Produce a before/after table for a defined test corpus, with raw logs and same workload for both runs.
features.constraint_or_tradeoff: Targets below are design goals until benchmarked; not current performance measurements.

features.title: Offline field-research packet
features.user_value: Allow inscription study during poor connectivity without compromising citations.
features.mechanism: Prepare a license-filtered read-only packet of allowed metadata, textual evidence, thumbnails, queued questions and source links; reconcile annotations when connectivity returns.
features.acceptance_test: Airplane-mode review retains source ID and location; denied or unlicensed original images are not bundled.
features.constraint_or_tradeoff: Remote changes require explicit conflict resolution and source/version awareness.

features.group: VI. Creative practice, access, and publication
features.title: Explicitly modern design studio
features.user_value: Create new bind-rune-inspired artwork without presenting design choices as ancient evidence.
features.mechanism: Provide a stroke-based vector canvas with script-aware glyph palette, layering, mirroring, snapping, undo, provenance labels, and optional personal meanings kept separate from scholarly readings.
features.acceptance_test: A user can create, revise and export an original contemporary sigil while the historical-origin field remains MODERN DOCUMENTED.
features.constraint_or_tradeoff: No magical efficacy or claimed historical continuity is asserted by the editor.
features.inspiration: Contemporary graphic editing / rune script data

features.group: VI. Creative practice, access, and publication
features.title: Portable creation receipt
features.user_value: Preserve a design author, intent and dates so future shares do not rewrite its origin.
features.mechanism: Export a companion JSON receipt with creation timestamp, author-controlled label, input runes, meanings chosen, graphical operations, inspirations, licensing and revision hash.
features.acceptance_test: A downstream reader can reconstruct which parts were historically copied, artistically transformed or personally invented.
features.constraint_or_tradeoff: Optional private intentions must be redacted from public exports by default.

features.group: VI. Creative practice, access, and publication
features.title: Three-lens interpretation panel
features.user_value: Serve historians, curious beginners and living practitioners without collapsing their claims.
features.mechanism: Present HISTORICAL ATTESTATION, SCHOLARLY INTERPRETATION and CONTEMPORARY PRACTICE as parallel views with independent citations, audience-friendly definitions and conflicts visible.
features.acceptance_test: A modern intention-based association remains visible as a modern practice while an unsupported ancient attribution is corrected.
features.constraint_or_tradeoff: Do not imply any contemporary belief needs scholarly confirmation to be meaningful as contemporary practice.

features.group: VI. Creative practice, access, and publication
features.title: Appropriation and misuse context pane
features.user_value: Avoid treating every rune as innocent in every context or automatically accusing people who use a similar glyph.
features.mechanism: Attach sourced modern extremist/völkisch uses, historical distinctions, contextual disambiguation and risk of misrecognition to specific documented variants and contexts.
features.acceptance_test: A symbol can be labeled historically runic and separately identified as appropriated in a documented modern setting without guilt-by-shape claims.
features.constraint_or_tradeoff: Context must be supported by evidence, not identity profiling or blanket symbolic bans.

features.group: VI. Creative practice, access, and publication
features.title: Interoperable evidence pack publisher
features.user_value: Let independent researchers audit and reuse the output without requiring the original chat.
features.mechanism: Export citation-rich Markdown plus canonical JSON/CSV, source crosswalk, manifest, checksums and, only when supported, EpiDoc/TEI-compatible text and IIIF/W3C annotations.
features.acceptance_test: An exported claim preserves its source/witness/region references, usage rights, uncertainty and design version on round-trip reimport.
features.constraint_or_tradeoff: Compatibility must be tested with real examples; a JSON file alone is not full TEI or IIIF compliance.

features.group: VI. Creative practice, access, and publication
features.title: Adversarial fixture and correction gate
features.user_value: Prevent the exact misinformation patterns the project was created to challenge from returning in later versions.
features.mechanism: Maintain versioned positive, false-positive, unknown, rights-denied, illegible, reversed and mixed-alphabet test cases; publish diffs when corrections change a verdict.
features.acceptance_test: Every new release passes all mandatory error-injection cases and reports changed claim statuses without deleting former verdicts.
features.constraint_or_tradeoff: The fixture suite validates logic, not claims about inscriptions not actually researched.

groups: VI. Creative practice, access, and publication

referenced_comparators.name: Runor
referenced_comparators.evidence: Official description reports approximately 7,000 searchable inscriptions, map/location/text lookups and linked reports/images.
referenced_comparators.transfer: Adapt search, map and field-friendly finding to per-claim source anchors.
referenced_comparators.limit: A portal search result is not itself proof of ritual function or access to an unrestricted API.

referenced_comparators.name: RuneS-DB
referenced_comparators.evidence: Its project description outlines object, dating, context, transliteration, language and collection fields plus a cross-regional research remit.
referenced_comparators.transfer: Adopt object-context typologies and distinguish physical witness from interpretation.
referenced_comparators.limit: Site identifies its database as beta and flags potentially provisional records or incomplete functions.

referenced_comparators.name: Scandinavian Runic-text Database / Rundata
referenced_comparators.evidence: A database download is documented along with Open Database License and additional attribution, naming and notification conditions.
referenced_comparators.transfer: Use source-version snapshots and rights-aware metadata import as a major complement to live search.
referenced_comparators.limit: Follow the actual reuse conditions; downloads and APIs are not interchangeable.

referenced_comparators.name: Menota Handbook ch. 18
referenced_comparators.evidence: Describes encoding of runic inscriptions, with dedicated bind-rune sections including word-crossing ligatures.
referenced_comparators.transfer: Adopt structured ligature, segmentation and transliteration alternatives.
referenced_comparators.limit: A technical encoding convention is not proof of any inscription's magical purpose.

referenced_comparators.name: EpiDoc
referenced_comparators.evidence: Uses TEI-derived conventions for editorial representation of ancient texts and material contexts.
referenced_comparators.transfer: Make transcription readings and restorations machine-comparable, with lossless source citations.
referenced_comparators.limit: Full schema export needs real conformance tests; no false compatibility badge.

referenced_comparators.name: IIIF
referenced_comparators.evidence: Stable Image and Presentation 3.0 specifications document region and page-level viewing and annotations; a 4.0 presentation candidate is not the stable base.
referenced_comparators.transfer: Anchor cropped portions and folio positions directly in source imagery.
referenced_comparators.limit: Each host must actually expose compatible manifests/images with lawful reuse.

referenced_comparators.name: W3C Web Annotation
referenced_comparators.evidence: A W3C Recommendation structures shareable annotations and resource selectors.
referenced_comparators.transfer: Use selectors for inspectable symbol-to-source links rather than screenshots without provenance.
referenced_comparators.limit: Selectors require a stable actual target and testing across image transformations.

referenced_comparators.name: Handrit manuscript catalogue
referenced_comparators.evidence: A primary manuscript catalogue and digitized manuscript lead is listed in v2, but direct entry retrieval was blocked in the present browsing environment.
referenced_comparators.transfer: Define a manuscript witness and folio verification adapter with explicit blocked-access states.
referenced_comparators.limit: No claim of having independently viewed a Huld folio in this research pass.
